description: Provision an Azure Servicebus NamespacesTopic via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the servicebus.azure.com/v1api20240101 NamespacesTopic spec.

autoDeleteOnIdle.description:
AutoDeleteOnIdle: ISO 8601 timespan idle interval after which the topic is automatically deleted. The minimum duration
is 5 minutes.

azureName.description:
AzureName: The name of the resource in Azure. This is often the same as the name of the resource in Kubernetes but it
doesn't have to be.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.
credentialFrom.title: Azure credential Secret

defaultMessageTimeToLive.description:
DefaultMessageTimeToLive: ISO 8601 Default message timespan to live value. This is the duration after which the message
expires, starting from when the message is sent to Service Bus. This is the default value used when TimeToLive is not
set on a message itself.

duplicateDetectionHistoryTimeWindow.description:
DuplicateDetectionHistoryTimeWindow: ISO8601 timespan structure that defines the duration of the duplicate detection
history. The default value is 10 minutes.

enableBatchedOperations.description: EnableBatchedOperations: Value that indicates whether server-side batched operations are enabled.

enableExpress.description:
EnableExpress: Value that indicates whether Express Entities are enabled. An express topic holds a message in memory
temporarily before writing it to persistent storage.

enablePartitioning.description: EnablePartitioning: Value that indicates whether the topic to be partitioned across multiple message brokers is enabled.

maxMessageSizeInKilobytes.description:
MaxMessageSizeInKilobytes: Maximum size (in KB) of the message payload that can be accepted by the topic. This property
is only used in Premium today and default is 1024.

maxSizeInMegabytes.description:
MaxSizeInMegabytes: Maximum size of the topic in megabytes, which is the size of the memory allocated for the topic.
Default is 1024.

operatorSpec.description:
OperatorSpec: The specification for configuring operator behavior. This field is interpreted by the operator and not
passed directly to Azure

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.

labels.description: Labels is an optional set of labels to apply to the destination resource.

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes configmap or secret to write to.
The configmap or secret will be created in the same namespace as the resource.

value.description:
Value is a CEL expression. The CEL expression may return a string or a map[string]string. For more information
on CEL in ASO see https://azure.github.io/azure-service-operator/guide/expressions/

owner.description:
Owner: The owner of the resource. The owner controls where the resource goes when it is deployed. The owner also
controls the resources lifecycle. When the owner is deleted the resource will also be deleted. Owner is expected to be a
reference to a servicebus.azure.com/Namespace resource

requiresDuplicateDetection.description: RequiresDuplicateDetection: Value indicating if this topic requires duplicate detection.

supportOrdering.description: SupportOrdering: Value that indicates whether the topic supports ordering.
